verdict.rationale: The source is public on GitHub (ghostty-org/ghostty), which says anyone can use libghostty to build or embed a terminal, and community users build Ghostty from source on Debian/Ubuntu and NixOS. However, no item in the pack names the license or confirms it is OSI-approved. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. a LICENSE file or SPDX name), documentation of what the license permits for the full app as well as the library.
